transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yeah, this is Rakesh. Listen, I’ve missed a couple of payments already. Can you just waive the fees or something? And wait, am I talking to a robot? Because this sounds kinda robotic.
I've noted that, and a human agent will call you back about it — I can't approve anything myself.

A human agent, huh? This is getting frustrating. How many times do I have to say I can’t pay right now? If you don’t help, I’m seriously tweeting about this whole experience. Is that the only way to get some real help?

I understand this situation is very frustrating, and I truly apologize for the inconvenience caused. I am an automated assistant here to help with your pending payment. For concerns about fee waivers and further assistance, I will arrange for a human agent to call you back who can help in more detail.

Is there a particular time you’d like to receive a callback from our team?

Honestly, I don’t know when I’ll be free. Just make sure the person who calls back actually knows what they’re doing and isn’t some bot like you. And again, can you just tell me if there’s any way to get those fees waived? Because I can’t find that info anywhere.
